sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Know Your Place! is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Came here just when I needed you! I found a new delivery route across the city. Well, not exactly found it, per se. Someone moved a package from the city center to Ultra twice as fast as usual. These guys must have found a veteran guide who's been here before all the electronics were shut down... Maybe even someone like this crazy guerilla mushroom guy, you heard of him? He'd show up out of nowhere, even been taken captive. But he always found a way to get out and lose his pursuers. Either way, we need to take control of the route. Find the place where those smugglers emerge from, and show everyone that this is now Ragman's route! So yeah, go ahead and scare everyone off in the city and near Ultra."

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:
- Eliminate any 5 targets on Streets of Tarkov (In one raid)
- Use the transit from Streets of Tarkov to Interchange (In one raid)
- Eliminate any 5 targets on Interchange (In one raid)

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +28,800 EXP
- Ragman Rep +0.03
- 95,000 Roubles
  - 99,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 109,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
- 2× Peltor ComTac VI headset (Coyote Brown)
"I think we got the wrong guys, man. Someone came by and told me that this route is used by some very important people. Should've thought this through..."

sections.heading: Streets of Tarkov to Interchange
sections.text: Southwest of the Concordia apartment complex. Transits are only available 1 min after raid start.
